sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Mount Balrior's capstone fight — a defiance bar that reopens every 5% health, and a geyser-management problem that snowballs if ignored.

sections.heading: Rising Pressure & breakbar
bullets: Ura maintains Rising Pressure, a stacking buff that increases her damage and reduces damage taken as the fight goes on — breaking her defiance bar (which unlocks every 5% health) stuns her and strips it. Don't fall behind on breaks.
Standing in Sulfuric Geysers grants her stacking Protection/Might/Resolution — destroy or avoid geysers rather than letting them sit.

sections.heading: Key attacks
bullets: Eruption Vent: targeted geysers that burn — don't stand in the impact zone.
Pressure Blast: imprisons a target in an eruption — clear it with a bloodstone shard.
Return: a whirlpool that pulls players in and teleports them to the arena center — be ready for the sudden reposition.
Steam Prison: reflects projectiles and blocks escape — don't rely on ranged burst or movement skills to get out of it.

sections.heading: Adds
bullets: Titanspawn spawn alongside the geysers — manage both at once rather than tunnel-visioning on the boss.
